senses.label: fabric
senses.definitionEn: a strong man-made fabric often used for clothes

examples.en: This shirt is made of 100% polyester.
examples.tr: Bu gömlek yüzde yüz polyesterden yapılmış.

examples.en: Polyester dries quickly, so it is good for sports clothes.
examples.tr: Polyester çabuk kurur, bu yüzden spor kıyafetleri için iyidir.

examples.en: The lab tested a blend of cotton and polyester.
examples.tr: Laboratuvar pamuk ve polyester karışımını test etti.

senses.label: becoming smaller
senses.definitionEn: the amount by which something becomes smaller, for example after washing

examples.en: We measured the shrinkage after three washes.
examples.tr: Üç yıkamadan sonra çekme miktarını ölçtük.

examples.en: Some shrinkage is normal with cotton clothes.
The shrinkage was less than two percent.

senses.label: the way something looks
senses.definitionEn: the way someone or something looks

examples.en: The appearance of the fabric changed after washing.
Don't judge people by their appearance.
She cares a lot about her appearance.

senses.label: sewn line
senses.definitionEn: the line where two pieces of cloth are sewn together

examples.en: The seam on my jeans has split.
examples.noteTr: has split: yeni olmuş bir durum (present perfect)

examples.en: Check the seams for any loose threads.
examples.tr: Dikiş yerlerinde gevşek iplik olup olmadığını kontrol et.

examples.en: The side seam twisted after the first wash.
examples.tr: İlk yıkamadan sonra yan dikiş kaydı.

senses.label: one movement of thread
senses.definitionEn: one movement of a needle and thread through cloth, or the small line it makes

examples.en: One stitch came loose after washing.
My grandmother sews with very small, neat stitches.
examples.tr: Büyükannem çok küçük ve düzgün dikişlerle diker.

examples.en: Can you fix this stitch on my sleeve?

senses.label: keeping colour
senses.definitionEn: the ability of a fabric to keep its colour without fading or running

examples.en: The lab checks colourfastness to washing and light.
examples.tr: Laboratuvar yıkamaya ve ışığa karşı renk haslığını kontrol eder.
examples.noteTr: colourfastness to + isim: -e karşı renk haslığı

examples.en: Poor colourfastness means the colour may run in the wash.
examples.tr: Düşük renk haslığı, rengin yıkamada akabileceği anlamına gelir.

examples.en: Did the red fabric pass the colourfastness test?
examples.tr: Kırmızı kumaş renk haslığı testini geçti mi?

senses.label: cleaning clothes
senses.definitionEn: the act of cleaning clothes with water and soap; also the clothes that need cleaning

examples.en: I usually do the washing on Sundays.
The colour faded after repeated washing.
Put the washing on the line to dry.

senses.label: removing water
senses.definitionEn: the process of removing water from something

examples.en: Tumble drying can make wool jumpers smaller.
examples.tr: Kurutma makinesinde kurutmak yün kazakları küçültebilir.

examples.en: Line drying is cheaper and better for the planet.
examples.tr: İpte kurutmak daha ucuz ve gezegen için daha iyidir.

examples.en: Record the drying time for each sample.
examples.tr: Her numune için kuruma süresini kaydedin.

senses.label: size or amount measured
senses.definitionEn: a size or number that you find by using a tool such as a ruler

examples.en: The tailor took my measurements for the suit.
examples.tr: Terzi takım elbise için ölçülerimi aldı.

examples.en: We repeated each measurement three times.
Is this measurement in centimetres or inches?
examples.tr: Bu ölçü santimetre mi inç mi?

senses.label: level of quality / rules
senses.definitionEn: a level of quality, or a set of rules that something should follow

examples.en: The fabric must meet the international standard.
examples.noteTr: meet a standard: bir standardı karşılamak

examples.en: This restaurant has very high standards.
Our work did not reach the expected standard.

senses.label: way of doing
senses.definitionEn: a planned way of doing something

examples.en: Which method did you use to calculate the result?
examples.tr: Sonucu hesaplamak için hangi yöntemi kullandın?

examples.en: This test method is described in the standard.
Every teacher has a different teaching method.
examples.tr: Her öğretmenin farklı bir öğretme yöntemi vardır.

senses.label: science room
senses.definitionEn: a room or building where scientific tests are done

examples.en: The samples were sent to the laboratory on Monday.
Students must wear safety glasses in the laboratory.
examples.tr: Öğrenciler laboratuvarda koruyucu gözlük takmak zorundadır.

examples.en: She works in a small laboratory near the factory.
examples.tr: Fabrikanın yakınındaki küçük bir laboratuvarda çalışıyor.

commonMistakesTr: equipment sayılamaz: 'equipments' denmez, tek bir alet için 'a piece of equipment' denir.

senses.label: tools and machines
senses.definitionEn: the tools and machines you need for a particular job or activity

examples.en: The new equipment arrived at the lab yesterday.
We need some camping equipment for the trip.
examples.tr: Gezi için biraz kamp malzemesine ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: This piece of equipment is very expensive.

senses.label: giving information
senses.definitionEn: the act of giving written or spoken information about something

examples.en: Accurate reporting is an important part of lab work.
examples.tr: Doğru raporlama laboratuvar işinin önemli bir parçasıdır.

examples.en: The reporting period ends on the last day of March.
examples.tr: Raporlama dönemi mart ayının son günü sona erer.

examples.en: I like the newspaper's careful reporting.

grammarNoteTr: in compliance with + isim: -e uygun olarak

senses.label: following rules
senses.definitionEn: the act of following a rule, law or standard

examples.en: All products are tested for compliance with safety rules.
examples.tr: Tüm ürünler güvenlik kurallarına uygunluk açısından test edilir.

examples.en: The report confirms full compliance with the standard.
The company acted in compliance with the new law.
examples.tr: Şirket yeni yasaya uygun hareket etti.

commonMistakesTr: 'Sınava girmek' için 'pass' değil 'take an exam' kullanılır; 'pass' sınavı geçmek demektir.

senses.label: succeed in a test
senses.definitionEn: to be successful in an exam or test

examples.en: Did you pass your driving test?
examples.noteTr: pass a test: sınavı geçmek; take a test: sınava girmek

examples.en: The fabric passed all the washing tests.
I'm sure you will pass the exam if you study.

senses.label: give by hand
senses.definitionEn: to give something to someone by putting it into their hand

examples.en: Could you pass me the salt, please?
She passed the note to her friend.

senses.label: middle value
senses.definitionEn: the number you get when you add amounts together and divide by how many there are

examples.en: On average, I sleep seven hours a night.
examples.tr: Ortalama olarak gecede yedi saat uyurum.

examples.en: Calculate the average of the three results.
Her grades are well above average.

senses.label: part of 100
senses.definitionEn: an amount shown as a part of 100

examples.en: What percentage of students passed the test?
A large percentage of our customers shop online.
examples.tr: Müşterilerimizin büyük bir yüzdesi internetten alışveriş yapıyor.

examples.en: Write the shrinkage as a percentage.

senses.label: become smaller
senses.definitionEn: to become smaller in size, number or amount

examples.en: The number of visitors decreased last year.
The width decreased by two percent after washing.
examples.tr: Yıkamadan sonra genişlik yüzde iki azaldı.

examples.en: Prices usually decrease after the holidays.

senses.label: not the same
senses.definitionEn: the way in which two things are not the same

examples.en: What's the difference between these two shirts?
examples.tr: Bu iki gömlek arasındaki fark nedir?
examples.noteTr: the difference between A and B: A ile B arasındaki fark

examples.en: A kind word can make a big difference.
examples.tr: Nazik bir söz büyük fark yaratabilir.

examples.en: There is a small difference in colour.

senses.label: being alike
senses.definitionEn: the way in which two things or people are like each other

examples.en: There is a strong similarity between the two sisters.
examples.tr: İki kız kardeş arasında güçlü bir benzerlik var.

examples.en: The similarities between the two methods are clear.
I can't see any similarity in their styles.

senses.label: find using maths
senses.definitionEn: to find a number or amount by using maths

examples.en: Can you calculate the total cost for me?
examples.tr: Toplam maliyeti benim için hesaplayabilir misin?

examples.en: We calculated the shrinkage for each sample.
It's hard to calculate how long the trip will take.
examples.tr: Yolculuğun ne kadar süreceğini hesaplamak zor.

commonMistakesTr: İsim 'record' /ˈrekərd/, fiil 'record' /rɪˈkɔːrd/ okunur; vurgu yeri değişir.

senses.label: write down / store
senses.definitionEn: to write down or store information, sound or pictures so they can be used later

examples.en: Please record the temperature every hour.
The band recorded their first album in a garage.
examples.tr: Grup ilk albümünü bir garajda kaydetti.

examples.en: Have you recorded all the results?

senses.label: find who/what
senses.definitionEn: to find or recognize who or what someone or something is

examples.en: We need to identify the cause of the problem.
Can you identify the man in this photo?
Scientists have identified a new type of insect.
examples.tr: Bilim insanları yeni bir böcek türü tespit etti.

senses.label: find out facts
senses.definitionEn: to try to find out the facts about something

examples.en: The police are investigating the accident.
We investigated why the colour faded so quickly.
examples.tr: Rengin neden bu kadar çabuk solduğunu araştırdık.

examples.en: The study investigates how children learn languages.
examples.tr: Çalışma, çocukların dilleri nasıl öğrendiğini inceliyor.

senses.label: keep safe
senses.definitionEn: to keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

examples.en: Sunglasses protect your eyes from the sun.
We must protect the forests for future generations.
This cover protected the phone when I dropped it.
examples.tr: Telefonu düşürdüğümde bu kılıf onu korudu.

commonMistakesTr: 'depend of' veya 'depend from' yanlıştır; doğrusu 'depend on'.

senses.label: be decided by / need
senses.definitionEn: to be decided by something else; to need someone or something

examples.en: Our plans depend on the weather.
Are you coming tonight? Well, it depends on my boss.
examples.tr: Bu akşam geliyor musun? Şey, patronuma bağlı.

examples.en: Children depend on their parents for many years.

senses.label: happen
senses.definitionEn: to happen, especially without being planned

examples.en: The accident occurred late at night.
examples.tr: Kaza gece geç saatte meydana geldi.

examples.en: Errors may occur if the machine is not cleaned.
It never occurred to me to ask her.

senses.label: make happen
senses.definitionEn: to make something happen, usually something bad

examples.en: Heavy rain caused traffic problems in the city.
examples.tr: Şiddetli yağmur şehirde trafik sorunlarına neden oldu.

examples.en: Hot water can cause shrinkage in wool.
examples.tr: Sıcak su yünde çekmeye neden olabilir.

examples.en: I'm sorry for causing so much trouble.
examples.tr: Bu kadar soruna yol açtığım için üzgünüm.

senses.label: reason (noun)
senses.definitionEn: the thing that makes something happen

examples.en: What was the cause of the fire?
Bad planning was the main cause of the delay.

commonMistakesTr: 'affect' fiildir (etkilemek), 'effect' isimdir (etki); 'affect on' denmez, 'have an effect on' denir.

senses.label: change / influence
senses.definitionEn: to change or influence someone or something

examples.en: The cold weather affected our plans.
Does temperature affect the test results?
Lack of sleep can affect your mood.

senses.label: strong effect
senses.definitionEn: a strong effect that something has on someone or something

examples.en: Social media has a big impact on young people.
examples.tr: Sosyal medyanın gençler üzerinde büyük bir etkisi var.
examples.noteTr: have an impact on: ... üzerinde etkisi olmak

examples.en: We studied the impact of washing on colour.
The new rule had little impact on sales.
examples.tr: Yeni kuralın satışlar üzerinde az etkisi oldu.

senses.label: make possible
senses.definitionEn: to make it possible for someone to do something

examples.en: The scholarship enabled her to study abroad.
examples.tr: Burs, onun yurt dışında okumasını mümkün kıldı.

examples.en: This app enables you to learn new words quickly.
examples.tr: Bu uygulama yeni kelimeleri hızlıca öğrenmeni sağlar.

examples.en: Please enable notifications in the settings.

senses.label: include as a part
senses.definitionEn: to include something as a necessary part, or to make someone take part

examples.en: The job involves a lot of travelling.
The test involves washing the fabric five times.
examples.tr: Test, kumaşı beş kez yıkamayı içerir.

examples.en: Try to involve everyone in the discussion.

commonMistakesTr: Durum fiilidir: 'This box is containing...' yerine 'This box contains...' kullanılır.

senses.label: have inside
senses.definitionEn: to have something inside or as a part

examples.en: This box contains old photos.
Does this cake contain nuts?
The report contained several mistakes.

commonMistakesTr: 'is consisted of' yanlıştır; edilgen kullanılmaz, doğrusu 'consists of'.

senses.label: be made of
senses.definitionEn: to be made of particular parts or things

examples.en: The team consists of five engineers.
Breakfast consisted of bread, cheese and olives.
examples.tr: Kahvaltı ekmek, peynir ve zeytinden oluşuyordu.

examples.en: The course consists of ten short lessons.

senses.label: not include
senses.definitionEn: to not include something or someone; to keep someone out

examples.en: The price on the menu excludes tax.
Don't exclude anyone from the game.
We excluded two samples because they were damaged.
examples.tr: Hasarlı oldukları için iki numuneyi hariç tuttuk.

senses.label: take away
senses.definitionEn: to take something away from a place or get rid of it

examples.en: Please remove your shoes before you come in.
examples.tr: Lütfen içeri girmeden önce ayakkabılarınızı çıkarın.

examples.en: This soap removes stains easily.
Remove the samples from the machine after washing.

collocations: separate the whites from the colours
commonMistakesTr: Yazımı 'seperate' değil 'separate'dir.

senses.label: move apart
senses.definitionEn: to divide something into parts or move things apart

examples.en: Separate the white clothes from the coloured ones.
examples.noteTr: separate A from B: A'yı B'den ayırmak

examples.en: The teacher separated the two noisy boys.
examples.tr: Öğretmen iki gürültücü çocuğu birbirinden ayırdı.

examples.en: Oil and water always separate after a few minutes.
examples.tr: Yağ ve su birkaç dakika sonra hep ayrışır.

senses.label: join together
senses.definitionEn: to join or mix two or more things together

examples.en: Combine the flour and sugar in a bowl.
examples.tr: Unu ve şekeri bir kasede karıştır.

examples.en: She combines work and study very well.
examples.tr: İşi ve okulu çok iyi bir şekilde bir arada yürütüyor.

examples.en: We combined the results of both tests.

senses.label: split into parts
senses.definitionEn: to separate something into parts or groups

examples.en: Divide the class into four groups.
Twelve divided by three is four.
examples.tr: On iki bölü üç dört eder.

examples.en: We divided the pizza between the five of us.

senses.label: choose
senses.definitionEn: to choose something from a group, usually carefully

examples.en: Select a language from the list.
Three samples were selected at random.
She was selected for the national team.

commonMistakesTr: 'prefer A than B' yanlıştır; doğrusu 'prefer A to B'.
grammarNoteTr: prefer A to B; prefer to + fiil

senses.label: like more
senses.definitionEn: to like one thing more than another

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.noteTr: prefer A to B: A'yı B'ye tercih etmek

examples.en: Do you prefer the window or the aisle seat?
examples.tr: Cam kenarını mı koridor tarafını mı tercih edersin?

examples.en: She preferred to stay at home last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece evde kalmayı tercih etti.

senses.label: know again
senses.definitionEn: to know who or what someone or something is because you have seen or heard them before

examples.en: I didn't recognize you with short hair!
Do you recognize this old song?
It is important to recognize your own mistakes.

commonMistakesTr: 'teach' ile 'learn' karıştırılır: öğretmen 'teaches', öğrenci 'learns'. 'He learned me' yanlıştır.

senses.label: give lessons
senses.definitionEn: to help someone learn something by giving lessons or showing them

examples.en: My mother teaches English at a high school.
Can you teach me how to swim?
My grandfather taught me to play chess.

senses.label: do again to improve
senses.definitionEn: to do something again and again so that you get better at it

examples.en: I practice speaking English with my friends.
You need to practice every day.
She practiced the piano for two hours.
Practice makes perfect, so keep trying!
examples.tr: Pratik mükemmelleştirir, o yüzden denemeye devam et!

commonMistakesTr: 'repeat again' gereksiz tekrardır; sadece 'repeat' yeterlidir.

senses.label: say or do again
senses.definitionEn: to say or do something again

examples.en: Could you repeat the question, please?
Listen and repeat after me.
examples.tr: Dinleyin ve benden sonra tekrar edin.

examples.en: We repeated the test to check the results.
examples.tr: Sonuçları kontrol etmek için testi tekrarladık.

senses.label: change / study again
senses.definitionEn: to change something to make it better or more correct; to study again before an exam

examples.en: I need to revise for my maths exam.
examples.tr: Matematik sınavım için tekrar çalışmam gerekiyor.
examples.noteTr: revise for: ... için tekrar yapmak (İngiliz İngilizcesi)

examples.en: The company revised its prices in January.
Please revise the report before you send it.
examples.tr: Lütfen raporu göndermeden önce gözden geçir.

senses.label: learn exactly
senses.definitionEn: to learn something so well that you can remember it exactly

examples.en: I memorize ten new words every day.
examples.tr: Her gün on yeni kelime ezberliyorum.

examples.en: Did you memorize your new password?
Actors have to memorize long scripts.

senses.label: picture in the mind
senses.definitionEn: to make a picture of something in your mind

examples.en: Imagine living on a small island.
examples.tr: Küçük bir adada yaşadığını hayal et.

examples.en: I can't imagine life without my phone.
She imagined herself as a famous singer.
examples.tr: Kendini ünlü bir şarkıcı olarak hayal etti.

senses.label: answer without knowing
senses.definitionEn: to give an answer without knowing for sure

examples.en: Guess who I saw at the market today!
examples.tr: Bil bakalım bugün pazarda kimi gördüm!

examples.en: I didn't know the answer, so I guessed.
examples.tr: Cevabı bilmiyordum, o yüzden tahmin ettim.

examples.en: Can you guess how old she is?
examples.tr: Kaç yaşında olduğunu tahmin edebilir misin?

senses.label: want / hope for someone
senses.definitionEn: to want something that is not possible or not likely; to hope that something good happens to someone

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
examples.tr: Keşke daha fazla boş zamanım olsa.
examples.noteTr: I wish + past simple: şimdiyle ilgili 'keşke'

examples.en: We wish you a happy birthday!
He wished me luck before the interview.
examples.tr: Mülakattan önce bana iyi şanslar diledi.

commonMistakesTr: 'enjoy to swim' yanlıştır; doğrusu 'enjoy swimming'.

senses.label: get pleasure
senses.definitionEn: to get pleasure from something

examples.en: I really enjoy cooking for my friends.
examples.tr: Arkadaşlarım için yemek yapmaktan gerçekten keyif alıyorum.

examples.en: Did you enjoy the film last night?
Enjoy yourselves at the party tonight!

senses.label: dislike very much
senses.definitionEn: to dislike something or someone very much

examples.en: I hate waking up early on weekends.
examples.tr: Hafta sonları erken kalkmaktan nefret ederim.

examples.en: My little brother hates green vegetables.
examples.tr: Küçük erkek kardeşim yeşil sebzelerden nefret eder.

examples.en: I hate it when people are late.

commonMistakesTr: 'trust to someone' denmez; 'trust someone' veya 'trust in someone' kullanılır.

senses.label: believe in someone
senses.definitionEn: to believe that someone is honest and will not hurt you, or that something is safe

examples.en: You can trust me with your secret.
I don't trust that old ladder.
She has always trusted her own judgement.

commonMistakesTr: Fiil olarak 'respect to someone' denmez; doğrudan nesne alır: 'respect your teachers'.

senses.label: admire / treat politely
senses.definitionEn: to admire someone and treat them or their ideas in a polite way

examples.en: We should respect other people's opinions.
Students respected the old teacher a lot.
examples.tr: Öğrenciler yaşlı öğretmene çok saygı duyardı.

examples.en: Please respect the rules of the library.

senses.label: go to see
senses.definitionEn: to go to see a person or a place for a short time

examples.en: We visit our grandparents every summer.
examples.tr: Her yaz büyükanne ve büyükbabamızı ziyaret ederiz.

examples.en: Have you ever visited Cappadocia?
Many tourists visit the old city in spring.
examples.tr: Birçok turist ilkbaharda eski şehri ziyaret eder.

senses.label: present people / bring in
senses.definitionEn: to tell people each other's names when they first meet; to bring in something new

examples.en: Let me introduce you to my sister.
examples.noteTr: introduce A to B: A'yı B ile tanıştırmak

examples.en: Can I introduce myself? I'm the new manager.
examples.tr: Kendimi tanıtabilir miyim? Ben yeni müdürüm.

examples.en: The school introduced a new uniform this year.
examples.tr: Okul bu yıl yeni bir forma getirdi.

senses.label: mark a special day
senses.definitionEn: to do something enjoyable because of a special day or event

examples.en: How do you celebrate New Year in your country?
We celebrated her birthday at a small cafe.
examples.tr: Doğum gününü küçük bir kafede kutladık.

examples.en: Let's celebrate the end of the exams!

commonMistakesTr: 'congratulate for' yerine 'congratulate on' kullanılır.

senses.label: praise success
senses.definitionEn: to tell someone that you are happy about their success or good news

examples.en: I called to congratulate her on her new job.
examples.tr: Yeni işi için onu tebrik etmek amacıyla aradım.

examples.en: The manager congratulated the team on their hard work.
examples.tr: Müdür ekibi sıkı çalışmaları için tebrik etti.

examples.en: Let me congratulate you on passing the exam.
examples.tr: Sınavı geçtiğin için seni tebrik edeyim.

senses.label: stop being angry
senses.definitionEn: to stop being angry with someone who has done something wrong

examples.en: Please forgive me for being so late.
examples.tr: Bu kadar geç kaldığım için lütfen beni affet.

examples.en: She never forgave him for lying.
examples.tr: Yalan söylediği için onu asla affetmedi.

examples.en: It's not easy to forgive a close friend.
examples.tr: Yakın bir arkadaşı affetmek kolay değil.

senses.label: disagree angrily
senses.definitionEn: to speak angrily to someone because you do not agree

examples.en: My neighbours argue about money all the time.
I don't want to argue with you.
The children argued over the last biscuit.
examples.tr: Çocuklar son bisküvi için kavga etti.

senses.label: give reasons
senses.definitionEn: to give reasons why you think something is true

examples.en: Some experts argue that homework is not useful.
examples.tr: Bazı uzmanlar ödevin faydalı olmadığını savunuyor.

examples.en: The writer argues that cities need more parks.
examples.tr: Yazar, şehirlerin daha fazla parka ihtiyacı olduğunu öne sürüyor.

commonMistakesTr: 'advise' fiildir (/z/ sesi), 'advice' isimdir (/s/ sesi); 'an advice' denmez, 'some advice' denir.

senses.label: tell what to do
senses.definitionEn: to tell someone what you think they should do

examples.en: My teacher advised me to read more books.
examples.tr: Öğretmenim bana daha fazla kitap okumamı tavsiye etti.

examples.en: What would you advise me to do?
We advise customers to wash this shirt in cold water.
examples.tr: Müşterilere bu gömleği soğuk suda yıkamalarını tavsiye ediyoruz.

senses.label: have to pay back
senses.definitionEn: to have to pay or give something back to someone

examples.en: I still owe you twenty lira for lunch.
examples.tr: Öğle yemeği için sana hâlâ yirmi lira borcum var.

examples.en: How much do I owe you?
I think you owe her an apology.

senses.label: keep for later
senses.definitionEn: to keep money or something else so that you can use it later

examples.en: I'm saving money for a new laptop.
examples.tr: Yeni bir dizüstü bilgisayar için para biriktiriyorum.

examples.en: We saved a lot by cooking at home.
examples.tr: Evde yemek yaparak çok tasarruf ettik.

examples.en: Don't forget to save your work before you close the file.
examples.tr: Dosyayı kapatmadan önce çalışmanı kaydetmeyi unutma.

senses.label: rescue
senses.definitionEn: to make someone or something safe from danger

examples.en: The firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
Wearing a seat belt can save your life.

senses.label: use badly
senses.definitionEn: to use something badly or use more of it than you need

examples.en: Don't waste your money on things you don't need.
examples.tr: Paranı ihtiyacın olmayan şeylere boşa harcama.

examples.en: I wasted the whole afternoon watching videos.
examples.tr: Bütün öğleden sonrayı video izleyerek boşa geçirdim.

examples.en: That meeting was a complete waste of time.
examples.tr: O toplantı tam bir zaman kaybıydı.

commonMistakesTr: Çalışarak para kazanmak 'earn money', yarışma/oyun kazanmak 'win' ile söylenir; 'I win 2000 lira a month' yanlıştır.

senses.label: get money / deserve
senses.definitionEn: to get money for the work you do; to get something because you deserve it

examples.en: She earns a good salary as a nurse.
examples.tr: Hemşire olarak iyi bir maaş kazanıyor.

examples.en: How much do you earn per hour?
He earned the respect of his colleagues.

senses.label: ask a price
senses.definitionEn: to ask someone to pay a certain amount of money for something

examples.en: The hotel charges extra for breakfast.
examples.tr: Otel kahvaltı için ekstra ücret alıyor.

examples.en: How much do they charge for a haircut?
examples.tr: Saç kesimi için ne kadar alıyorlar?

examples.en: The shop didn't charge us for delivery.
examples.tr: Mağaza teslimat için bizden ücret almadı.

senses.label: add electricity
senses.definitionEn: to put electricity into a battery

examples.en: I need to charge my phone before we leave.
examples.tr: Çıkmadan önce telefonumu şarj etmem gerekiyor.

examples.en: The car charges in about four hours.
examples.tr: Araba yaklaşık dört saatte şarj oluyor.

senses.label: worth / importance
senses.definitionEn: how much something is worth in money, or how important or useful it is

examples.en: This old watch has great value to me.
examples.tr: Bu eski saatin benim için büyük değeri var.
examples.noteTr: value to someone: biri için değer

examples.en: The house has doubled in value since 2015.
examples.tr: Ev 2015'ten beri değerini iki katına çıkardı.

examples.en: The lunch menu is good value for money.
examples.tr: Öğle menüsü fiyatına göre çok iyi.

examples.en: Record the average value for each sample.
examples.tr: Her numune için ortalama değeri kaydedin.

senses.label: having a value
senses.definitionEn: having a particular value; good or useful enough to do

examples.en: This painting is worth a lot of money.
The museum is definitely worth visiting.
Was the long trip worth it?

grammarNoteTr: be unlikely to + fiil; it is unlikely that + cümle

senses.label: probably not
senses.meaningTr: olası değil, olasılığı düşük, pek mümkün değil
senses.definitionEn: probably not going to happen or be true

examples.en: It's unlikely to rain this afternoon.
examples.tr: Bu öğleden sonra yağmur yağması pek olası değil.

examples.en: He is unlikely to finish the work by Friday.
examples.tr: İşi cumaya kadar bitirmesi pek mümkün değil.

examples.en: It seems highly unlikely that she forgot.

senses.label: without doubt
senses.definitionEn: without any doubt; also used to say yes politely

examples.en: Could I see the menu? Certainly, here you are.
This is certainly the best pizza in town.
examples.tr: Bu kesinlikle şehirdeki en iyi pizza.

examples.en: The new method will certainly save time.

senses.label: perhaps
senses.definitionEn: perhaps; used when something may be true or may happen

examples.en: The meeting will possibly finish late today.
Could you possibly open the window?
examples.noteTr: Could you possibly...?: çok kibar rica

examples.en: It was possibly the worst day of my life.
examples.tr: Belki de hayatımın en kötü günüydü.

commonMistakesTr: Yazımı 'definately' değil 'definitely'dir.

senses.label: without doubt
senses.definitionEn: without any doubt

examples.en: I'll definitely call you tomorrow.
This is definitely not my bag.
Are you definitely coming to the party?

senses.label: easy to see or understand
senses.meaningTr: açıkça, net bir şekilde, belli ki
senses.definitionEn: in a way that is easy to see, hear or understand

examples.en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
examples.tr: Herkes duyabilsin diye lütfen net konuş.

examples.en: The instructions were clearly written.
She was clearly tired after the long day.
examples.tr: Uzun günün ardından belli ki yorgundu.

senses.label: easy to see
senses.definitionEn: in a way that is easy for anyone to see or understand

examples.en: He was obviously nervous before the exam.
Obviously, we can't finish everything today.
The machine is obviously broken.

senses.label: by good luck
senses.meaningTr: neyse ki, çok şükür, şans eseri
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something good happened by luck

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the accident.
I missed the bus, but fortunately another one came soon.
examples.tr: Otobüsü kaçırdım ama neyse ki kısa süre sonra başka biri geldi.

examples.en: Fortunately, all the samples passed the test.
examples.tr: Neyse ki tüm numuneler testi geçti.

senses.label: sadly
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is sad or not what you wanted

examples.en: Unfortunately, the shop was already closed.
I can't come tonight, unfortunately.
Unfortunately, the colour faded after one wash.
examples.tr: Ne yazık ki renk bir yıkamadan sonra soldu.

commonMistakesTr: 'because' + cümle, 'because of' + isim: 'because it rained' / 'because of the rain'.

senses.label: as a result of
senses.definitionEn: as a result of; for the reason of

examples.en: The flight was late because of the snow.
We stayed inside because of the heat.
Because of you, I passed the exam!

grammarNoteTr: as a result of + isim: ...in sonucu olarak

senses.label: so / consequently
senses.definitionEn: used to show that something happens because of something else

examples.en: It rained all night. As a result, the roads were flooded.
examples.tr: Bütün gece yağmur yağdı. Sonuç olarak yolları su bastı.

examples.en: He trained hard and, as a result, won the race.
examples.tr: Sıkı çalıştı ve sonuç olarak yarışı kazandı.

examples.en: The water was too hot. As a result, the shirt shrank.
examples.tr: Su çok sıcaktı. Bunun sonucunda gömlek çekti.

senses.label: showing difference
senses.definitionEn: used to show that two things are very different

examples.en: The north is cold. In contrast, the south is warm all year.
examples.tr: Kuzey soğuktur. Buna karşılık güney bütün yıl sıcaktır.
examples.noteTr: In contrast to + isim de kullanılır

examples.en: In contrast to his brother, Ali is very quiet.
examples.tr: Erkek kardeşinin aksine Ali çok sessizdir.

examples.en: Cotton shrank a lot; polyester, in contrast, did not change.
examples.tr: Pamuk çok çekti; polyester ise buna karşılık değişmedi.

senses.label: different point
senses.definitionEn: used to introduce a different point of view or fact

examples.en: The city is exciting. On the other hand, it's very expensive.
examples.tr: Şehir heyecan verici. Öte yandan çok pahalı.
examples.noteTr: çoğu zaman 'On the one hand...' ile eşleşir

examples.en: This phone is cheap; on the other hand, the camera is poor.
examples.tr: Bu telefon ucuz; öte yandan kamerası kötü.

examples.en: On the other hand, working from home can feel lonely.
examples.tr: Öte yandan evden çalışmak insana yalnızlık hissettirebilir.

senses.label: because of this
senses.definitionEn: because of the thing that was just mentioned

examples.en: The roads are icy. For this reason, schools are closed today.
examples.tr: Yollar buzlu. Bu nedenle okullar bugün kapalı.

examples.en: Wool can shrink. For this reason, wash it in cold water.
examples.tr: Yün çekebilir. Bu sebeple soğuk suda yıka.

examples.en: She loves animals, and for this reason she became a vet.
examples.tr: Hayvanları çok seviyor ve bu nedenle veteriner oldu.

senses.label: in addition to
senses.meaningTr: ...nın yanı sıra, hem ... hem de, ayrıca
senses.definitionEn: in addition to; and also

examples.en: She speaks French as well as English.
examples.tr: İngilizcenin yanı sıra Fransızca da konuşuyor.

examples.en: The lab tests colour as well as shrinkage.
examples.tr: Laboratuvar çekmenin yanı sıra rengi de test eder.

examples.en: As well as cooking, he does all the cleaning.
examples.tr: Yemek yapmanın yanı sıra bütün temizliği de o yapıyor.

grammarNoteTr: no longer + fiil = not ... any more

senses.label: not now
senses.definitionEn: not now, although it was true in the past

examples.en: I no longer live in Ankara.
This model is no longer available.
They are no longer friends after the argument.

senses.label: not until now
senses.definitionEn: still to happen, but probably soon

examples.en: Have you finished your homework? Not yet.
The results are not yet ready.
I have not yet decided where to go.

senses.label: immediately / together
senses.definitionEn: immediately; also, together in the same moment

examples.en: Come to my office at once, please!
I can't do two things at once.
The waiter came at once when we called him.

senses.label: immediately
senses.definitionEn: immediately; without waiting

examples.en: I'll send you the file right away.
She recognized me right away.
Can you call me back right away?

senses.label: sometimes
senses.meaningTr: arada bir, ara sıra, zaman zaman
senses.definitionEn: sometimes, but not often

examples.en: We eat out once in a while.
examples.noteTr: genelde cümle başında ya da sonunda gelir

examples.en: Once in a while, I like to be alone.
It's good to take a break once in a while.

senses.label: sometimes
senses.definitionEn: sometimes, but not regularly

examples.en: I still see my old classmates from time to time.
examples.tr: Eski sınıf arkadaşlarımı hâlâ zaman zaman görüyorum.

examples.en: From time to time, the machine makes a strange noise.
examples.tr: Makine zaman zaman garip bir ses çıkarıyor.

examples.en: We all make mistakes from time to time.

senses.label: sometimes
senses.definitionEn: sometimes, but not often or regularly

examples.en: Every now and then, my uncle sends us a postcard.
examples.tr: Amcam arada sırada bize kartpostal gönderir.

examples.en: I check my email every now and then.
It's nice to eat something sweet every now and then.
examples.tr: Arada sırada tatlı bir şey yemek güzel.

senses.label: usually / overall
senses.definitionEn: usually; when you think about most cases

examples.en: In general, I prefer summer to winter.
examples.tr: Genel olarak yazı kışa tercih ederim.

examples.en: People in general like good news.
In general, the test results were good.

senses.label: especially
senses.definitionEn: especially; more than others

examples.en: I love fruit, strawberries in particular.
examples.tr: Meyveyi, özellikle de çileği çok severim.

examples.en: Is there anything in particular you want to eat?
examples.tr: Özellikle yemek istediğin bir şey var mı?

examples.en: One sample in particular showed high shrinkage.
examples.tr: Özellikle bir numune yüksek çekme gösterdi.

senses.label: not planned
senses.definitionEn: without planning or wanting to

examples.en: I deleted the file by accident.
We met by accident at the airport.
Sorry, I took your pen by accident.

senses.label: intentionally
senses.definitionEn: because you wanted to, not by accident

examples.en: Did you break the glass on purpose?
I'm sure he didn't do it on purpose.
She arrived early on purpose to get a good seat.
examples.tr: İyi bir yer kapmak için bilerek erken geldi.

senses.label: before
senses.definitionEn: before a particular time or event

examples.en: Please book your tickets in advance.
Thanks in advance for your help.
We paid for the hotel two weeks in advance.
examples.tr: Otelin parasını iki hafta önceden ödedik.

senses.label: where others can see
senses.definitionEn: where other people can see or hear you

examples.en: He doesn't like speaking in public.
They had a big argument in public.
examples.tr: Herkesin önünde büyük bir tartışma yaşadılar.

examples.en: She sang in public for the first time.
examples.tr: İlk kez herkesin önünde şarkı söyledi.

senses.label: with no one else
senses.definitionEn: with no other people present

examples.en: Can I talk to you in private?
The manager discussed the problem in private.
They got married in private, without a big party.
examples.tr: Büyük bir düğün yapmadan, sessizce evlendiler.

commonMistakesTr: 'at first' (başta, sonra değişti) ile 'first/firstly' (sıralama: ilk olarak) karıştırılır.

senses.label: at the beginning
senses.definitionEn: in the beginning, before something changed

examples.en: At first, I didn't like my new school.
examples.noteTr: genelde sonra bir değişiklik gelir (but now...)

examples.en: The work was hard at first, but now it's easy.
examples.tr: İş başlangıçta zordu ama şimdi kolay.

examples.en: At first I thought she was joking.

senses.label: finally
senses.definitionEn: after a long time of waiting or trying

examples.en: At last, the weekend is here!
We found the hotel at last.
After many tries, she passed her driving test at last.
examples.tr: Birçok denemeden sonra sonunda ehliyet sınavını geçti.

senses.label: short time
senses.definitionEn: during a period of time, usually not very long

examples.en: Let's sit here for a while.
I haven't seen him for a while.
The power was off for a while last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece elektrik bir süre kesikti.
